break the rule and pay.text: The rule is simple and absolute, and the whole story waits for the moment it is broken. In Kwaidan, [a young woodcutter is spared by a snow spirit on condition he never speaks of that night|1964-kwaidan], and years later, by candlelight, he tells the story. In Sumpah Orang Minyak, [Si Bongkok is made handsome once he swears never to kill another person|1958-sumpah-orang-minyak], and when he breaks the oath his beauty turns invisible to everyone. The most common rule in the record, carried by a quarter of all films, it grows after the 1970s and runs strongest in South and East Asia.

calling it brings it.text: Some things wait quietly until they are called, by name or by rite, and once called they do not leave. In Los Angeles, [Sarah and three outcast girls call on Manon to cast their spells|1996-the-craft], and every spell comes back twisted. A kindly woman from Annie's support group [teaches her a séance to reach the dead|2018-hereditary], while in Adelaide [a severed hand and the words talk to me bring a dead stranger into the room|2022-talk-to-me]. Absent before 1960, it has crept upward since and is most common in films made after 2015.

death on a deadline.text: The clock becomes the monster's accomplice, counting down to an hour everyone can name. In Ringu, [Reiko watches the tape, the phone screeches, and she has seven days|1998-ringu]. By the talisman's terms in Siccin, [Nisa and everyone of her blood will die once five night prayers have passed|2014-siccin], and in Talk to Me [the hand must be pulled away within ninety seconds|2022-talk-to-me]. As old as the record and most frequent in the films of 2000 to 2014, it travels widely, with Southeast Asia, South Asia and Latin America all carrying more than their share.

death sends warnings.text: Death sends word ahead, and the warning only pulls the knot tighter. Architect Walter Craig [tells the guests at a Kent cottage he has seen them all in a dream that ends in something awful|1945-dead-of-night]. In Venice, [two elderly sisters bring word that John Baxter is in danger and must leave|1973-don-t-look-now], and in apartment 13B [a television serial shows Manohar's family what is about to happen to them|2009-13b]. Rare in most eras, it crowds into the films of 2000 to 2014, which hold nearly half its examples, and it runs strong in the UK and Ireland.

everything has a price.text: Every gift carries a hidden invoice, and someone always comes to collect. In The Killing of a Sacred Deer, [Martin calmly demands a life from Steven's family|2017-the-killing-of-a-sacred-deer], and until Steven chooses, his children lose the use of their legs. The Le Domas fortune came from [a great-grandfather's deal with a mysterious Le Bail|2019-ready-or-not], and in a derelict bathroom [a tape orders Lawrence to kill Adam by six o'clock|2004-saw] or lose his wife and daughter. The rule has climbed steadily since the 1960s and is at its strongest in the films made after 2015.

faith and charms protect.text: Against what cannot be killed, people raise small defences: a word on the wall, a circle on the floor, a light kept burning. In Chanderi, [townsfolk paint O Stree Kal Aana on their walls|2018-stree] to keep the spirit moving on. Near an Irish forest, [villagers tell Adam and Claire to put back the iron bars on the house|2015-the-hallow], and in Tumbbad [Vinayak carries a circle of flour and a dough doll|2018-tumbbad] when he goes down to steal from a starving god. Found across the world, it is especially strong in Sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East and Southeast Asia.

how it hunts.text: Every predator has its method, and learning it is the first small hope of surviving. Deep in an Appalachian cave, [pale, blind creatures hunt the scattered women by sound|2005-the-descent]. In a sorority house at Christmas, [Jess learns the obscene calls are coming from inside the house|1974-black-christmas], and in Bad City [the girl in the chador lets the men who prey on others take her home|2014-a-girl-walks-home-alone-at-night]. Rare before 1960, it has held a steady place in the record ever since the 1980s.

it can be undone.text: This rule leaves a door open: a rite to complete, a truth to uncover, a wrong to put right. In Philadelphia, [Malcolm urges Cole to learn what the ghosts need from him|1999-the-sixth-sense]. In Antonio Bay, [Father Malone reads in his grandfather's hidden diary how the founders wrecked the Elizabeth Dane|1980-the-fog], and outside Dakar [the lost men return at night inside the bodies of the living, making their demand|2019-atlantics]. It peaks in the 1980s and 1990s, and it is far more common in South and Southeast Asia than in Continental Europe.

it chooses who dies.text: The killing follows a pattern, and the worst of it is learning whether you fit. In Feng Shui, [each death is shaped by the victim's Chinese zodiac sign|2004-feng-shui], and anyone who sees their reflection in the bagua mirror is marked by their birth year. A fertility cult's price was the last child, and [six-year-old Ian turns seven in three days|2017-satan-s-slaves], while at a party in a secluded house [film buff Randy lays out the rules|1996-scream]. Common in most eras and at its height since 2015, it is strongest of all in the Middle East and North Africa.

it gets inside you.text: The most intimate rule says the danger can slip into a mind or body and steer it from within. When Rose's psychiatrist mother stirs a spoon in a teacup, [Chris drops into the sunken place|2017-get-out]. In Kurouzu-cho, [a girl's curls take over her mind|2000-uzumaki] as the spiral swallows the town, and at a tomb in Veerana [the witch's spirit enters little Jasmin|1988-veerana], who grows up to invite men back to the old mansion. Found in eighty-one films, it is common in every era, most of all before 1960 and again since 2015.

it has a fatal weakness.text: However strong it is, there is a way to end it, and the search for that way becomes the story. In Wisborg, [Ellen reads that only a pure-hearted woman's blood, freely given, can hold Count Orlok|1922-nosferatu]. In Rigor Mortis, [the coin mask on the corpse's face must stay on|2013-rigor-mortis], and in Antarctica [MacReady takes command, trusting no one and burning|1982-the-thing] his way through the station. The second most common rule in the record, it was at its peak before 1960, when nearly two films in five carried it.

it has unnatural powers.text: This rule gives the threat abilities no living thing should have, and each one closes off a way to escape. In Mystics in Bali, [Cathy's head tears free, trailing its organs, and flies off|1981-mystics-in-bali] to feed. Lestat turns a dying plague orphan, and [Claudia becomes a daughter whose mind grows old|1994-interview-with-the-vampire], while in Derry the children face [a creature that wears each child's worst fear|2017-it]. It is largely a North American rule, and not one film from Latin America, Africa or the Middle East carries it.

it must be let in.text: It cannot cross the threshold on its own, so it asks, and the horror lies in saying yes. In Blackeberg, [Eli asks Oskar to be invited in|2008-let-the-right-one-in], and Oskar learns what follows. In nineteenth-century Serbia, [a dead child begs at the farmhouse door to be let in|1963-black-sabbath], and in Adelaide [the words I let you in hand a player's body to the dead|2022-talk-to-me]. Rare everywhere, it is strongest in Australian films, where three of fifteen carry it.

it must feed.text: The hunger cannot be argued with, and every meal only teaches it to ask for more. At veterinary school, [Justine's shameful appetite drives her from a stolen burger to raw chicken to her sister's severed finger|2016-raw]. On a Welsh island, [a goddess lies bound in tree roots and fed on blood|2018-apostle], and in Santa Carla [Michael shuns the light and begins to crave blood|1987-the-lost-boys]. Steady in every era since the 1960s, the rule runs especially strong in Australia and New Zealand.

it passes to others.text: It travels on from victim to victim, by bite, by blood, by the simple act of watching. In Cambridge, [the rage virus leaps from a freed chimpanzee to the activists within seconds|2002-28-days-later]. In Seattle, Rachel plays the tape and [her son Aidan is soon marked as well|2002-the-ring], and in Raw [an appetite that runs in the family|2016-raw] begins to surface in Justine. Strongest in the films of 2000 to 2014, it runs deep in East Asia and in the UK and Ireland.

it wears a familiar face.text: The danger arrives wearing a face that is already trusted. At an Antarctic research station, [an organism that can perfectly imitate any living thing|1982-the-thing] leaves MacReady trusting no one. In Woodsboro, [suspicion slides between Sidney's boyfriend, her friends and her absent father|1996-scream], and in wartime Tehran, as the neighbours flee, [Shideh and Dorsa are left alone with a chador|2016-under-the-shadow] and a tale of djinn. It is overwhelmingly a North American rule, holding nineteen of its twenty-eight films, and it surges after 2015.

no one believes you.text: The cruellest part is being right and alone with it. In Haddonfield, [Laurie Strode's friends laugh off her fears|1978-halloween] while Michael Myers shadows her through the day. In the outback, [Jake Cullen stands trial for his grandson's murder|1984-razorback] because no one believes a giant boar took the boy, and in Venice [John Baxter scoffs at the sisters' warning|1973-don-t-look-now]. It is strongest in the 1960s and 1970s and in Latin America, and not one Continental European film in the record carries it.

nothing can stop it.text: It is shot, burned, buried or torn to pieces, and still it comes back. [Amelia tears up the Mister Babadook book, but it returns to her doorstep reassembled|2014-the-babadook], with new pages showing her killing the dog, her son and herself. In When Evil Lurks, [every warning ignored lets the evil leap to someone new|2023-when-evil-lurks], and in Kurouzu-cho [the whole town is caught in the spiral|2000-uzumaki]. Common in every era, it peaks in the films of 2000 to 2014, when nearly one in five carries it.

only some can see it.text: What stalks these films hides in plain sight, visible only to a child, a camera or one stubborn witness. At Bly, [Miss Giddens sees a man and a woman in the grounds that only she seems to notice|1961-the-innocents]. In Shutter, [pale shadows and faces surface in Tun's photographs|2004-shutter], and in Derry [no adult sees what the Losers Club see|2017-it]. It is there from the earliest films, at its strongest before 1960, and it runs deep in Continental European cinema.

people turn on each other.text: Here the danger is other people and the rules they enforce: ordeals that prove guilt, torture that produces confessions, threats that keep the frightened silent, deaths quietly staged as accidents. It runs from Häxan and Freaks through Witchfinder General and Don't Torture a Duckling to Eden Lake, Green Room and Speak No Evil. It turns up in every era, a rule that never needed the supernatural, and every one of its films comes from North America, Europe or Asia.

reality comes apart.text: The floor of the world gives way, and the laws that hold time, space and story stop holding. In Funny Games, [when the family finally strikes back, Paul rewinds the film itself|1997-funny-games]. Beneath Hanging Rock [both watches stop at noon|1975-picnic-at-hanging-rock], and inside the Shimmer [time slips, radios die and plants grow into human shapes|2018-annihilation]. Almost absent before 1960, it takes hold in the 1980s and 1990s and has stayed ever since.

survivors can still win.text: Courage, love and plain stubbornness still count for something here, and sometimes they are enough. In Derry, [the Losers Club follow the sewer maps to an old well beneath a house on Neibolt Street|2017-it], because no adult sees what they see. In Blackeberg, [Eli urges Oskar to stand up to the boys who torment him|2008-let-the-right-one-in], after evenings spent only imagining revenge. A largely North American rule, holding twenty of its thirty films, it has a third of them from 2015 on and none at all from Southeast Asia.

the body changes.text: The body slips out of its owner's keeping, and the change, once begun, rarely turns back. On Moreau's island, [Lota's fingernails are turning back into claws|1932-island-of-lost-souls]. In Kurouzu-cho, [classmates slow down, sprout shells and climb the school walls|2000-uzumaki], and in Malaysia [Zaffan's skin breaks out and her nails start to fall away|2023-tiger-stripes]. It is oldest and strongest before 1960, when one film in eight carried it, and steady in every era since.

the dead do not rest.text: The dead stay on, in the house, in the photographs, in the hopes of those who loved them. On 1945 Jersey, [Grace finds an album of photographs of the dead|2001-the-others] as she grows sure the house is haunted. In a Hong Kong tower block, [a sweet old widow pays a black magician to bring her dead husband back|2013-rigor-mortis], and in Guatemala [the new maid Alma is seen wading through the pool into the house|2019-la-llorona]. It grows steadily across the century, and Continental Europe and Southeast Asia carry far more than their share.

tied to place or thing.text: It belongs somewhere, to a well, a tree or a tower block, and anyone who comes too close inherits its claim. In Chandanghat, [a man in Kumar's stolen coat dies beneath the tree where his father and grandfather were killed|1962-bees-saal-baad]. Reiko and Ryūji [follow the tape's images to Ōshima and to Sadako, sealed inside a well|1998-ringu], and in a decaying Hong Kong tower block [twin girl ghosts linger in the flat where they died|2013-rigor-mortis]. It surges after 2015, when two in five of its films were made, and South Asia carries far more than its share.

trapped with no way out.text: The door is locked, help is far away, and the place has decided who stays. Aboard a derelict ship orbiting Neptune, [Captain Miller's crew find themselves stranded|1997-event-horizon], each haunted by the people they failed. In the aunt's country house, [the house begins to eat Gorgeous and her six friends|1977-house-hausu], and on the express to Busan [the dead surge through the carriages|2016-train-to-busan]. Rare before 1960, it gathers from the 1980s on, and not one Southeast Asian film in the record carries it.
